title: Pseudo-differential Operators and Microlocal Analysis
journal: Master's Thesis (Mathematical Sciences), AIMS South Africa
abstract: Study of pseudo-differential operators in the framework of microlocal analysis. Exploring symbolic calculus, regularity properties in Sobolev spaces, and propagation of singularities.

title: Structural Robustness Analysis of an SEIR-B Model for Cholera
abstract: Development and analysis of a compartmental SEIR-B model for cholera dynamics in West Africa. Calculates the controlled reproduction rate with sensitivity analysis.
